lastResponse.text: First call the VA Community Resource and Referral Center at 8-7-7, 4-2-4, 3-8-3-8. If that doesn’t connect, call 5-0-3, 8-0-8, 1-2-5-6. Tell them he’s a veteran in Salem sleeping in his car and needs emergency housing help. They can start intake without documents, but he needs to be the one requesting services.
originalTexts: First call the **VA Community Resource and Referral Center** at **8-7-7, 4-2-4, 3-8-3-8**. If that doesn’t connect, call **5-0-3, 8-0-8, 1-2-5-6**. Tell them he’s a veteran in Salem sleeping in his car and needs emergency housing help. They can start intake without documents, but he needs to be the one requesting services.
